rounds.q: What does a first-class Forever stamp cost now, in cents?
rounds.why: It went up 4 cents on July 12, 2026, from 78 cents.
rounds.fun: The one thing in your junk drawer that keeps gaining value!

rounds.q: What year did the federal minimum wage become $7.25?
rounds.why: It was the last of three yearly raises from a 2007 law, and it hasn't moved since.
rounds.fun: The federal minimum wage is older than the iPad!

rounds.q: What % of US payments are made with cash?
rounds.why: Still, 76% of people carry some cash, about $69 on average.
rounds.src: Federal Reserve, Diary of Consumer Payment Choice (2026)
rounds.fun: About 1 in 7 payments is cash. It's still on the team, just mostly on the bench.

rounds.q: In 2024, about how many cents did it cost to make one penny?
rounds.why: It was 3.69 cents, up from 3.07. The US made its last penny in November 2025.
rounds.fun: Every penny cost almost 4 cents to make. Not a great deal!

rounds.q: On average, how many years does a $1 bill last?
rounds.why: It's 6.6 years. A $100 bill lasts 22.9, because people save those instead of spending them.
rounds.fun: Your dollar bill is younger than most of your socks!
